disputePackage.formalLetterText:
Date: October 24, 2026

To:
Patient Financial Services & Billing Department
Mercy General Hospital & Trauma Center
1200 Healthcare Blvd, Metro City, NY 10001

RE: Formal Notice of Disputed Billing Errors and Statutory Dispute
Patient Name: Sarah Jenkins
Account Number: ACC-99284-883
Statement Date: October 14, 2026
Disputed Amount: $1,650.00

Dear Billing Director,

Pursuant to the Fair Credit Billing Act (15 U.S.C. § 1666), Regulation Z (12 C.F.R. § 1026.13), and Internal Revenue Code Section 501(r), I am formally notifying your office of mathematical billing discrepancies, unauthorized duplicate charges, and excessive pricing markups on the above-referenced account.

Following a forensic review of the itemized statement, the following line items are formally disputed:

1. CPT 80053 (Comprehensive Metabolic Panel) - $280.00
   Grievance: Duplicate charge. This identical laboratory panel was billed twice on October 12, 2026. Under federal billing rules, duplicate billing is prohibited.

2. CPT 36415 (Routine Venipuncture) - $70.00
   Grievance: Quantity overbill. Venipuncture fees may only be billed once per clinical blood draw encounter according to CMS NCCI standards.

3. CPT 99284 (Emergency Department Level 4) - $1,850.00
   Grievance: Excessive markup. This fee exceeds 380% of the Medicare allowable median ($480.00). I request an adjustment reflecting your hospital's Amount Generally Billed (AGB) percentage under IRC § 501(r).

4. CPT 29125 (Application of Short Arm Splint) - $650.00
   Grievance: Excessive supply and application fee exceeding regional fair market benchmarks ($85 - $210).

STATUTORY DEMANDS:
1. Acknowledge receipt of this dispute letter within 30 days as mandated by federal law.
2. In accordance with 15 U.S.C. § 1666, immediately suspend all collection activity and withhold reporting this disputed balance to any credit reporting agency while this investigation remains pending.
3. Provide a revised itemized billing statement detailing standard CMS Revenue Codes and National Drug Codes (NDCs).
4. Provide a copy of your hospital's Plain Language Financial Assistance Policy (FAP) application.

Sincerely,

Sarah Jenkins
Account #ACC-99284-883
phoneNegotiationPoints: Step 1: Call 1-800-555-4321 and ask to speak directly with the Patient Financial Services Supervisor.
Step 2: Reference Account #ACC-99284-883 and state: 'I have conducted a forensic audit of this statement and identified duplicate billing for CPT 80053 and CPT 36415 totaling $350.00.'
Step 3: Ask: 'Can you immediately credit these two duplicate line items off my balance today?'

Step 4: For the ER facility fee markup: 'The facility fee on CPT 99284 is 380% above the regional Medicare median. I would like to request an adjustment to your hospital's Amount Generally Billed (AGB) rate under Section 501(r).'

Step 5: If the representative pushes back: 'Please place a 30-day administrative hold on this account while your billing compliance team reviews my written dispute letter, and mail me your Financial Assistance application.'
